title: [Pearls Before Brine, Deck]
description: Sheets of patched canvas stretch overhead, forming a sun-bleached awning above a broad, uneven deck.  A rusted anchor chain snakes between overturned crates forming makeshift tables, a variety of trinkets and wares piled on top.  Towards the bow, a pair of skull-shaped iron lanterns illuminate a narrow opening to a steep stairwell that leads down into the cargo hold.
